# Oxytocin Relationships

Editorial site covering oxytocin, romantic relationships, touch, couple conflict, jealousy, attachment, trust and social support.

## Core principles
- Primary research is linked directly.
- Endogenous oxytocin studies are distinguished from administered-oxytocin experiments.
- Findings are described as context dependent where appropriate.
- No dosing or self-administration instructions are provided.
- Commercial affiliation with OxytoZen Lab is disclosed.

## Key pages
- /index.html — overview of oxytocin and relationship science
- /science.html — source-linked research library
- /editorial-policy.html — editorial standards

## Commercial relationship
OxytoZen Lab is a separate affiliated research-reagent storefront. Product links are promotional referrals.
